question: The laundry basket held 72 pairs of socks. Fran added 24 pairs from the dryer, then put 42 pairs away in drawers. The washing machine runs for 40 minutes. Fran then counted the basket in single socks, since each pair is 2 socks. She washed 65 socks and hung them outside, lost 19 socks behind the machine, and gave 11 socks to the dog to chew. How many socks were left in the basket?

In the morning Ike started a puzzle game with 115 points and earned 46 points on the first level. In the afternoon he reached a level where every point he held was worth 4 points, then he found a chest worth 57 points and lost 79 points in a trap. In the evening he hit a level where every point he held was worth 7 points, and he finished with a bonus of 72 points. How many points did Ike have at the end of the evening?

Jo's lawn measured 76 square yards, and she added 36 square yards by clearing a couple of old flower beds. Since a square yard is 9 square feet, she measured the lawn in square feet for the turf order. She paved 423 square feet of it for a patio, then reclaimed 7 square feet by removing a path. Her neighbour Kim's lawn was 418 square feet smaller than Jo's. How many square feet was Kim's lawn?

In the morning a corner shop had 44 six-packs of lemonade on the shelf. The shop is open 10 hours a day. In the afternoon a delivery brought 22 more six-packs and a second van brought 11. Since a six-pack holds 6 cans, the owner counted the stock in cans. In the evening a party group bought 272 cans. How many cans of lemonade were left?

In the morning a bakery had 24 trays of bread. It sold 11 trays to a restaurant and then received 55 trays from its second kitchen. Each loaf weighs 500 grams. In the afternoon the staff counted loaves instead of trays, since every tray held 9 loaves, and every loaf was then cut into 4 quarters for the sandwich bar. In the evening the quarters were packed 6 to a bag. How many bags were packed?

A cafe fills a 149-gallon tank of water each day but has 130 gallons left every evening. Each cafe seats 30 people. The chain's 4 cafes all use the same amount. The chain logs water in pints, and since a gallon is 8 pints, the manager converted the daily figure to pints. He then worked out the weekly figure, since a week has 7 days, and added 29 pints for cleaning the tanks. How many pints of water does the chain use in a week?

A brewery had 239 crates of bottles, but 33 crates were damaged in transit. The brewery has 15 staff. Each crate holds 7 boxes, and each box holds 6 bottles. During the festival the brewery sold 7681 bottles. It then tripled its remaining stock with a new batch. How many bottles did the brewery have in stock?

In the morning Ray's dairy collected 81 gallons of milk. Since a gallon is 8 pints, and a pint is 2 cups, Ray recorded the morning's milk in cups. In the afternoon Sal's dairy reported 9 times as many cups as Ray's. Sal's dairy produced the same amount on each of 8 days. In the evening of the last day Sal added 36 cups from a spare churn and 74 cups from a late milking. How many cups of milk did Sal's dairy produce in all?

Tom's shop had 177 mugs in stock and received 39 more. Uma's shop across the road had 2 times as many mugs as Tom. Uma's shop is 6 years old. Uma took delivery of 75 mugs, then 36 more, and sold 142 mugs. Each of her remaining mugs was priced at 4 dollars. How many dollars were Uma's remaining mugs worth?

A bag of 105 sweets was shared equally among 3 children, and Vi was one of them. Vi then got 9 sweets from her aunt, 42 sweets from a party bag, and 75 sweets on Halloween. Her brother Wes ate all of his share, so Vi ended with more sweets than Wes. How many sweets did Vi have?

Yaz's orchard has 178 apple trees, and each tree gave 8 apples this year. Zia's orchard produced 5 times as many apples as Yaz's. Zia picked 9 more apples from a wild tree by the road. She then sold 1129 apples at the market. How many apples did Zia have left?

A cafe had 147 pints of milk in its fridge and used 139 pints over the weekend. A delivery on Monday brought 79 pints. The barista measures milk by the cup, and since a pint is 2 cups, she worked out the milk in cups. A neighbouring cafe lent her 41 cups of milk. How many cups of milk did the cafe have?

In the morning a shelter had 84 blankets, and a single van delivered 67 more. In the afternoon 140 blankets were handed out to families. In the evening a church sent 76 blankets and a school sent 78. How many blankets did the shelter have at the end of the evening?

A grower shared 152 apples equally between 2 market stalls. The stall is 3 metres long. At Al's stall every apple was cut into 4 wedges for tasting. A helper added 19 wedges from a spare apple bag and later 13 more. How many wedges did Al's stall have?

A bakery with a dozen ovens baked 124 cupcakes for a school. It added 68 cupcakes from a cancelled order and 24 from a test batch. The school is 2 miles away. The cupcakes were divided equally among 4 classrooms, and the teacher in Room A then added 35 cupcakes she had baked herself. How many cupcakes did Room A have?

In the morning a farmer collected 94 eggs from the main henhouse and 34 eggs from the small coop. In the afternoon she found that each of the farm's 9 henhouses had produced exactly that many eggs. In the evening a neighbour brought over a dozen eggs, and 3 more were found under the porch. How many eggs did the farmer have that evening?

In the morning Dan had 100 dollars and spent 81 dollars on groceries. In the afternoon he earned 20 dollars washing cars and 66 dollars mowing lawns, and his boss then tripled the cash he was holding as a bonus. He paid 2 dollars for parking. In the evening his aunt tripled whatever he had. How many dollars did Dan have at the end of the evening?

In the morning a food bank had 188 cans of soup, and it gave 95 cans to a single family in need. A neighbour then dropped off 22 cans. In the afternoon 59 cans were sent to a shelter. In the evening a supermarket replaced every remaining can with a six-pack of 6 cans, and a volunteer added 3 cans from her own cupboard. How many cans of soup did the food bank have?

In the morning 162 cookies were packed equally into 6 tins, and one tin was taken to the office. By mid-morning 10 cookies from that tin had been eaten. In the afternoon a colleague doubled what was left in the tin by adding the same number again, and then 27 cookies were eaten. In the evening the office manager doubled what remained in the tin. How many cookies were in the tin at the end of the evening?

Gil enrolled in a 22-week welding course, but 4 weeks were cancelled. Since a week is 7 days, the college wrote the course length in days. Gil has completed 125 days of the course. The college then added 43 days of workshop time, and afterwards doubled the remaining schedule to cover a new module. How many days of the course does Gil have left?

In the morning Jem had 125 marbles and lost 58 of them in a game. The game lasted 90 minutes. In the afternoon he won 52 marbles, then lost 82. In the evening his friend Kit, who had fewer marbles than Jem, gave him 75 marbles. How many marbles did Jem have at the end of the evening?

Mae's stationery shop received 7 boxes of pens with 164 pens in each box, more than Nat's shop received. Each pen costs 3 dollars. Mae sold 586 pens in the first month and 422 pens in the second month. She then restocked so that she had 9 pens for every pen left. A supplier sent 63 free pens, and a customer returned 43 pens. How many pens did Mae's shop have?

Ola's school fund had 190 dollars, more than Pia's fund had. The fund took in 25 dollars from a bake sale, 33 dollars from a raffle, and 67 dollars from a sponsor. It then paid 294 dollars for a trip and 7 dollars for bank charges. How many dollars were left in Ola's fund?

A cafe had 91 pints of milk and received a delivery of 78 pints. The cafe has 16 tables. It used 128 pints during the week and threw out 17 pints that had spoiled. The barista serves milk by the cup, and since a pint is 2 cups, she worked out the milk in cups. How many cups of milk did the cafe have?

In the morning Quin had 57 arcade tokens and spent 19 of them on a racing game. In the afternoon she exchanged every remaining token for 9 tickets, then shared the tickets equally between herself and her sister, 2 of them in all. In the evening each of Quin's tickets was worth 5 points at the prize counter. How many points did Quin have?
